vfh_board_desc: Post contracts here to hire wandering vikings. Only buildable at a base: a workbench, a bed and enough built pieces nearby.
vfh_confirm_dismiss: Dismiss $1? They'll leave and the contract ends. No refund.
vfh_confirm_remove: This board has $1 hirelings. Removing it ends every contract and they'll all leave. Remove it?
vfh_op_cancelled: Contract cancelled, fee returned to the board
vfh_op_cap: This board can't take more hirelings: upgrade it for more
vfh_op_funds: Not enough food or coins on the board
vfh_op_badlevel: This board can't hire at that level
vfh_op_job_locked: This board's level is too low for that job
vfh_msg_died: has died. Their contract is over.
vfh_msg_died_respawn: has died, and will be back once the board pays for it.
vfh_status_awaiting_payment: Waiting for the board to pay the respawn fee
vfh_status_no_input: Stations need ore or fuel, chests have none
vfh_upgrade_nonrefundable: Upgrade materials are used up: deconstructing the board only returns its build cost
vfh_upgrade_conflict: Someone else upgraded this board first: your materials were returned
vfh_upgrade_timeout: The upgrade didn't go through: your materials were returned
vfh_board_storage_reject: Only food and coins can go on the hiring board
vfh_base_need_workbench: Hiring board needs a workbench within $3 m
vfh_base_need_bed: Hiring board needs a bed within $3 m
vfh_base_need_pieces: Hiring board needs $2 built pieces within $3 m ($1/$2)
vfh_base_board_too_close: Another hiring board is $1 m away (min $2 m)
vfh_base_world_board_limit: This world already has $1 hiring boards (max $2)
